import json, subprocess, sys, time, string
AL = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits
def longname(i):
    # 125 labels of 'a' + a 2-char varying label  -> wire = 125*2 + 3 + 1 = 254
    lbl = AL[i // 36 % 36] + AL[i % 36]
    return '.'.join(['a'] * 125 + [lbl]) + '.'
